notes.title: Fishing & Friends | Demo Update 0.2.0
notes.notes:
Hello fellow ghouls, we're happy to announce our first big patch to the My Lil Afterlife Demo!

Aptly named Fishing & Friends, this patch adds the fishing system, meaning you can now spend your eternal life trying to catch some spooky fish. To start fishing you'll need to buy and equip a fishing rod and then interact with the fishing spots along the coastline. As you'll expect, you can fish up all sorts of items but mainly stinky fish, a new resource that can be used for crafting and summoning a new resident, Finley, to the afterlife.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466533/45241660184de39ab642d730af2a369f460d5c2e.png"]

As well as this, we've also expanded the playable island with a new beach to explore, added several new pieces of furniture to collect and added some new clothing items to wear, including pets for that sixth equipment slot that has remained unused until now! Pets can be found in blind boxes which randomly from from activities in the afterlife. This first wave of pets are elemental themed and drop from elemental blind boxes, so keep an eye out for those when playing.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466533/53ed68098b8f3fe9b54dcd24a5076ea1fa8eea52.png"]

As always the patch also includes some quality of life improvements and bug fixes but the full patch notes can be found below.



Changes & Bug Fixes:

Fishing system added, with the chance to catch stinky fish, bones, dead wood, and essence

Three fishing spots have been added to the coastline

Old Bones now sells a fishing rod and a bucket of bait

Finley, a new resident which sells bathroom furniture, can now be summoned to the afterlife

Two new pets can be found in elemental blind boxes which drop from activities in the afterlife

A new beach has been added to the island

The ghost ship now sails around the island

Further Japanese localisation added

Several spelling mistakes corrected



We hope you enjoy the patch, we have so much more planned for My Lil Afterlife, especially for the full game launch in October. But until then make sure to leave any feedback you have on the Steam discussion board, we want to create the best version of the game possible but we can't do that without your input on what you like, don't like or just needs fixing. Thanks!

notes.title: Demo Update 0.1.5 | Patch notes
notes.notes:
Hi all, this small update includes some initial localisation for the Japanese language. This will be an on going process over the course of several updates. If you spot any translations that are incorrect, please let us know on the discussion board.



Changes & Bug Fixes:

Japanese localisation added

Language drop down added to the main menu

Several UI elements updated to accommodate localisations

notes.title: Demo Update 0.1.4 | Patch notes
notes.notes:
Hi all, this small update includes some bug fixes for the gamepad controls for the My Lil Afterlife Demo.

Changes & Bug Fixes:

Tooltips no longer display twice when playing with a gamepad and keyboard/mouse
Fixed issue with the gamepad mouse click not working after creating a character
Fixed issue with the gamepad mouse click not working after accepting or declining a quest
You can no longer roll or go into decoration mode when creating a character

notes.title: Demo Update 0.1.3 | Patch notes
notes.notes:
Hi all, to make the controls more transparent when playing with a gamepad, we have added a controller layout window which can be accessed via the controller button on the main menu and controls menu. This window displays the base gamepad controls in an easy to read format, hopefully making it easier to play with a controller. This update also includes some new items to decorate with and wear.

Changes & Bug Fixes:

Controller layout window added, this can be accessed via the main menu and controls menu
Main menu tooltips now display correctly when using a controller
New room added to the reapers tower
Minor visual updates made to the reapers tower
Sassyquatch has some new items for sale
Alex-Mortis has some new items for sale

notes.title: Demo Update 0.1.2 | Patch notes
notes.notes:
Hi all, this update to the My Lil Afterlife demo builds out the controller support further and includes remappable hotkeys which can be changed via the controls window.

Changes & Bug Fixes:

Further controller support has been added
Keys can now be bound via the controls window in the settings menu
Holding the right click button and pausing the game will no longer hide the mouse cursor
Holding right click and opening the save menu will no longer lock the mouse to the centre of the screen when exiting


Following this patch we will be working on adding additional spirits and content as well as testing localisation. As always, if you spot any bugs or have any questions, make sure to pop onto our Steam discussion board and leave us a message. Thanks!

notes.title: Demo Update 0.1.1 | Patch notes
notes.notes:
Hi all, this update includes some minor bug fixes and changes to the settings menu for the My Lil Afterlife Demo. Following this patch we will be working on adding remappable hotkeys and extending the controller support further.

Changes & Bug Fixes:

Dying will no longer reset the screen resolution
Windowed mode will no longer reset the screen resolution to the lowest resolution
Sound volume buttons changed to a slider in the settings menu
Large Mouse cursor toggle button added to the settings menu
The pause menu feedback button now directs to the My Lil Afterlife feedback & bugs discussion board
Removed the pause menu save game button tooltip

Thank-you to the people who have downloaded the demo and wishlisted the game so far! If you spot any bugs or have any questions, make sure to pop onto our Steam discussion board and leave us a message. We want to make My Lil Afterlife the best it can be before it releases and we can't do that without your help and feedback.
